suites.description: Concurrent claims are atomic and same-project parallelism stays productive

checks.name: a live claim cannot be double-owned by a competing worker
independent tasks proceed concurrently without blocking each other
renewal extends only the holder's live lease

suites.description: Fencing prevents stale workers from mutating after losing ownership

checks.name: an expired claim is re-fenced and the prior generation cannot commit
released claims cannot commit and a later claim re-fences
fencing holds across repeated contention cycles

suites.description: Expired leases and resource claims are recovered deterministically

checks.name: expired claims cannot commit and expired resource claims are released with evidence
resource recovery fails closed on missing evidence or invalid claims

suites.description: Conflicting writes serialize while shared reads stay parallel

checks.name: shared claims coexist and exclusive claims serialize
a claim bundle cannot contain duplicate keys and is ordered deterministically
cross-project shared resources serialize without cross-scope mutation
project locks are fenced leases that cannot be stolen while live

suites.description: Duplicate runs, tasks and equivalent work are deduplicated

checks.name: run/task/equivalent-work duplicates are reported rather than executed twice
one active run per project and portfolio lane
commands are ordered by stop, pause, then start and coalesce deterministically
dispatch separates acceptance from execution claim

suites.description: Divergent outputs are arbitrated and high-risk work cannot self-certify

checks.name: overlapping divergent artifacts conflict instead of last-write-wins
high and critical risk require an independent verifier
